name: Desaix and Denon go up the Nile
traveler: General Desaix's division, with the artist Vivant Denon
summary: Sent to chase the Mamluk bey Murad into Upper Egypt, Desaix's division marches up the Nile to the first cataract. With it rides Vivant Denon, fifty-one years old, sketching temples under fire. His Voyage dans la Basse et la Haute Égypte of 1802 made Egypt's monuments famous across Europe, and opened the way for the great Description.

stops.note: The division sets out after Murad Bey.
Through Middle Egypt, fighting the Mamluks.
Denon sketches the temple of Hathor.
At the sight of the ruins, the whole division halts and applauds.
The southern limit; Denon draws the island temples.
Denon brings back his sketches and sails for France with Bonaparte in August.
